datasets.title: Xenograft mouse model to investigate tropism to the CNS and retina in primary central nervous system lymphoma (first batch)
datasets.summary: Primary diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) of the central nervous system (PCNSL) is a rare, extranodal lymphoma. Primary vitreo-retinal lymphoma (PVRL) occurs in 15-25% of PCNSL. CNS involvement also occurs in systemic diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, termed secondary central nervous system lymphoma (SCNSL). Despite intensive treatment, patient outcomes are poor when compared to DLBCL without CNS involvement. How and why lymphoma cells home to the CNS and vitreo-retinal compartment remains unknown. In vivo models to study lymphoma cell tropism are urgently needed. We therefore established and characterized 3 primary and 4 secondary patient-derived CNS lymphoma xenograft mouse models using immunohistochemistry, flow cytometry and nucleic acid sequencing technology. In spleen reimplantation experiments, we characterized the dissemination pattern of orthotopic and heterotopic xenografts and performed RNA sequencing to detect differences on the transcriptome level. Moreover, we found that lymphoma cells in PCNSL xenografts home to the eye after intrasplenal implantation in around 60% of cases, similar to PVRL. This in vivo tumor model preserves key features of this rare lymphoma entity and can be used to explore pathways that are critical for CNS and retinal tropism with the goal to find potential new targets for novel therapeutic approaches .

evidence.case_vs_control_differential: 仅6例肿瘤样本，无独立健康对照或正常脑组织，无法做差异分析
evidence.correlation: 患者仅6例<16，且无表型连续变量，相关性分析证据不足
evidence.sample_source: GSM source均为Brain，冻存肿瘤组织直接提RNA，未分选特定细胞类型，属实体组织直接测序。

datasets.title: Xenograft mouse model to investigate tropism to the CNS and retina in primary central nervous system lymphoma (second batch)
datasets.summary: Primary diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) of the central nervous system (PCNSL) is a rare, extranodal lymphoma. Primary vitreo-retinal lymphoma (PVRL) occurs in 15-25% of PCNSL. CNS involvement also occurs in systemic diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, termed secondary central nervous system lymphoma (SCNSL). Despite intensive treatment, patient outcomes are poor when compared to DLBCL without CNS involvement. How and why lymphoma cells home to the CNS and vitreo-retinal compartment remains unknown. In vivo models to study lymphoma cell tropism are urgently needed. We therefore established and characterized 2 primary and 2 secondary patient-derived CNS lymphoma xenograft mouse models using immunohistochemistry, flow cytometry and nucleic acid sequencing technology. In spleen reimplantation experiments, we characterized the dissemination pattern of orthotopic and heterotopic xenografts and performed RNA sequencing to detect differences on the transcriptome level. Moreover, we found that lymphoma cells in PCNSL xenografts home to the eye after intrasplenal implantation in around 60% of cases, similar to PVRL. This in vivo tumor model preserves key features of this rare lymphoma entity and can be used to explore pathways that are critical for CNS and retinal tropism with the goal to find potential new targets for novel therapeutic approaches .
datasets.overall_design: In total 4 human-derived xenograft (PDX) samples were analysed. Flow cytometry cell sorting with human CD19 antibody was used to isolate lymphoma cells from spleen or CNS PDX.

evidence.relevant: 研究PCNSL的CNS趋化性，含PCNSL患者来源异种移植淋巴瘤细胞的RNA-seq数据，目标疾病是主体且样本为PCNSL肿瘤细胞。
evidence.sequencing_type: 流式分选B淋巴瘤细胞群体的总RNA进行常规转录组测序，library_selection=cDNA，默认判定为mRNA-seq。
evidence.survival_analysis: 样本为PDX小鼠模型分离的淋巴瘤细胞，非人类患者，无生存时间/状态字段，下游无法做患者生存分析
evidence.treatment: 实验设计未涉及药物治疗对照，仅比较疾病亚型（PCNSL vs SCNSL）和组织部位（CNS vs Spleen），无药物干预轴
evidence.case_vs_control_differential: 所有样本均为B淋巴瘤细胞（SCNSL或PCNSL），无独立真健康对照，仅亚型/部位比较，无法做疾病vs正常差异分析
evidence.correlation: 仅4个样本，均为PDX肿瘤细胞，数量远不足≥16，无法进行可靠的相关性分析
evidence.sample_source: 4个样本均为人PDX移植瘤小鼠CNS/脾中FACS分选的hCD19+淋巴瘤细胞，未培养即测序，属分选的具体细胞类型，故为primary_cell。
